introHtml: Poly spandex fabric combines the durability of polyester with the stretch and recovery of spandex, making it ideal for apparel that needs to move with the wearer. Whether you are outfitting a warehouse team or a cycling club, this material resists wrinkles, holds its shape, and offers all-day comfort. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, long-lasting look.
heroAltText: Custom poly spandex apparel featuring a fitted polo shirt with embroidered logo on a white background.
